entities.summary: All Saints' Cathedral is an Anglican (Episcopal) church at 11 Pak Po Street and 2 Yim Po Fong Street, in Mong Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong. It was founded in Yau Ma Tei in 1891 on All Saints' Day.
